planes.frasePago: The plan is paid in full at sign-up. If your international card allows installments, the terms are set by your bank, not by drones.orientese.com.
planes.intro1: Informational hub. It does not sell or intermediate. The plan is paid in full to drones.orientese.com at sign-up or activation. If your international card allows installments, the bank sets the split. Free sign-up and use: October through December 2026. Deadline to activate those registrations: 31-12-2026 UTC.
planes.intro2: Plan length: 365 days. Activation on 1-1-2027 runs until 1-1-2028 at the rate you started with. Later renewals use the previous year's rate. Simulator clock: calendar month. StandShowTour and Mentora: in production. Clubs: scheduled.
planes.etapasTexto: E1 (activation ≤ 31 Dec 2026 UTC): 10 / 15 / 20 % → 89 / 224 / 263 USD. E2: 7 / 12 / 17 % → 92 / 231 / 273 USD. E3: 5 / 10 / 15 % → 94 / 237 / 280 USD. Then list rates 99 / 263 / 329 USD. INICIANTE stays at 66 USD / 365 days. Visible quota: 1800 paid sign-ups per plan (PLUS, PRO and ÉLITE), worldwide, per stage.
planes.extrasTexto: 1) +2 uses that day if the daily cap is hit (PLUS–ÉLITE max. 8 days/month; INICIANTE max. 4). 2) Bag at 0: +50 % once per calendar month. 3) Pack of 10 uses: INICIANTE 15 USD · PLUS 12 · PRO 10 · ÉLITE 8; max. 2 packs/month. Visitor cannot buy extras. In Oct–Dec 2026 the trial has no extras. Logbook, NOTAM and altimeter: words only at this stage.
planes.cambioTexto: Switching to a more economical plan may create a price difference charged at the time of the change, either in favor of drones.orientese.com in money or in favor of the person changing plan, with extra simulator uses and/or extra sends of staff requests and/or sales of drones, parts or accessories in good condition. No money is refunded. The box “I already exceeded 400 h” enables an upgrade; it does not remove you.

puntos: Once per person. Not renewable as Iniciante.
